notes.title: Hidden v1.4 is live!
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!
We are pleased to announce the addition of Turkish language!!

Changelog:

- Added Turkish subs. Thank you very much OyunCeviri!!
- Minor corrections on some texts.

Please do contact us if you encounter any issues. Either here on Steam or send a mail to contact@lostspell.com

We really appreciate your support!
Lost Spell Team

notes.title: Hidden v1.3 is live!
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!
We are pleased to announce the addition of Russian and Greek languages!!

Changelog:

- Added Russian subs. Thank you very much Prometheus Project!!
- Added Greek subs. Thank you very much Cristina and Aris!!
- Some minor fixes.

Remember we are working with the community to translate Hidden to other languages. If you’re interested in translating Hidden into your native language, please contact as either here on Steam or send a mail to contact@lostspell.com

Please do contact us if you encounter any issues. Either here on Steam or send a mail to support@lostspell.com

We really appreciate your support!
Lost Spell Team

notes.title: Hidden v1.1 is live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We added the missing subs and fixed some minor bugs.

Changelog:

- Added subtitles for cinematics and dialogs (now all the game have subs).
- Fixed some typos.
- Fixed a minor bug inside the shelter.
- Fixed an error related  to the ritual.

Please do contact us if you encounter any issues. Either here on Steam or send a mail to contact@lostspell.com

We really appreciate your patience and your support!
Lost Spell Team

notes.title: Subs and new languages
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!
Hidden has finally been released and we want to let you know our next priorities:


 Subtitles: As you know the game have subs but not for cinematics and dialogs with characters. We are adding these missing ones and we spect to have them over the next few weeks.
 Fixes: Please do contact us if you encounter any issues. Either here on Steam or send a mail to contact@lostspell.com
 Localization: In the next days we will start with new fan translations. We are working with the community and right now we have 2 languages confirmed: Russian and Greek.



If you’re interested in translating Hidden into your native language, please contact as either here on Steam or send a mail to contact@lostspell.com


Thank you for supporting us by purchasing Hidden: On the trail of the Ancients!
Lost Spell Team
